headline: Lucy Davis, Star of ‘The Office’ U.K., Shares Terminal Cancer Diagnosis
context: Lucy Davis, who portrayed the timid, frustrated Dawn Tinsley in the original version of “The Office,” said she had been diagnosed with Stage 4 breast cancer.

sources.name: The New York Times
